Variants.Content: Entry The Bloodstone Emperor is rumored to be the brother who usurped the throne of the Amethyst Queen, and is also the core figure in the Kingdom of Dawn's fall into darkness. Legend links it to parricide, black stone worship, forbidden rituals, and the Long Night; these accusations have strong moral overtones and should be understood as mythical sins
